auth_email_user_deletion_auto_canceled_s:
Hi {name},

Your account was scheduled for permanent deletion, but we noticed you are now the sole owner of one or more organizations. We've canceled the deletion and reactivated your account so those organizations are not left without an administrator.

If you still want to delete your account, please transfer ownership of those organizations to another member first, then request deletion again.
Hi {name}, your account deletion was canceled because you are the sole owner of one or more organizations. Transfer ownership before re-requesting deletion.
Your account deletion was canceled — you're a sole owner
auth_email_user_deletion_canceled_body:
Hi {name},

We received a sign-in on your account, so the pending deletion has been canceled. Your account is active again and no data has been removed.

If you did not sign in, please change your password immediately and contact support.
auth_email_user_deletion_canceled_plaint: Hi {name}, your account deletion was canceled because you signed back in. If this was not you, change your password and contact support.
auth_email_user_deletion_complete_body:
Hi {name},

Your account and all associated data have been permanently deleted. This is the last email you will receive from us.

Thank you for using our service.
auth_email_user_deletion_complete_plaint: Hi {name}, your account has been permanently deleted. This is the last email you will receive from us.
auth_email_user_deletion_scheduled_body:
Hi {name},

Your account is scheduled to be permanently deleted on {scheduledFor}. If you did not request this, or if you change your mind, just sign back in before that date and the deletion will be canceled automatically.

If you did request this, no further action is needed — we will send one final email when the deletion is complete.

If you did not request this, please change your password immediately and contact support.
